bio: This sleek minimalist interior draws sushi fans like bees to honey. Whether it is a classic salmon maki wrapped in a soy crepe or a more inventive sushi of smoked eel and red beetroot, Junko Kawada effortlessly combines purity of flavour with cutting-edge Japanese precision. The offer is varied and also features sashimi and salads, without forgetting a knockout range of teas to take home and sushi lessons....
